remarks:
Sellers will consider offers from $599,999-$629,999. 
Welcome to your ultimate move in ready dream home, where timeless design meets modern sophistication. this home is perfectly situated near a highly desired golf course and has Country Club amenities. This property offers an elevated lifestyle with recreation, relaxation, and scenic surroundings all within walking distance. A Golfers Dream Home location!
 This newly renovated 2,553 sq ft, 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath house, delivers a seamless blend, featuring high end design and superior craftsmanship form top to bottom. 
The heart of the home is a chef inspired kitchen designed for both entertaining and every day indulgence. This kitchen is anchored by a beautiful island, with gorgeous granite countertops throughout, soft close cabinets and a coffee bar.
Next, you'll take a walk into an expansive, light-filled family/living space where you can imagine morning coffee looking out of the beautiful picturesque windows. There is a sun/patio room toward the front of the house with double French doors set against a back drop of uninterrupted views of a pristine Golf Course. An additional living space addition toward the back of the home looking out into the concrete patio with fenced in yard for privacy and elevated entertaining. The Master bedroom suite is a large spacious room, with abundant natural light serene atmosphere. Just beyond, the en-suite bath continues the experience with a spa inspired design, featuring a glass enclosed walk-in shower, a dual sink vanity, and beautifully crafted vanity with quartz counters. Everything in this home has been remodeled, and new including the roof with covered warranty, windows, siding, paving, with 2 car garage, new AC, plumbing, and electrical.

Tax records indicate 2272 sq ft. Addition was built toward back of home and sq footage obtained and appraised at 2,553 sq ft.

This is more then a renovation, this is a lifestyle upgrade. A rare opportunity to own a truly turn-key luxury home in this neighborhood, where no detail has been overlooked. Everything is in easy reach to popular restaurants, and local shops in town.
